QuestInfo.name: Battle Mode...Begin!
QuestInfo.0: Let the festivities begin! Listen to #b#p9070005##k tell you all about the thrills of Battle Square.
QuestInfo.1: Go to #b#m960000000##k as #p9070005# described. You can go to Battle Square by talking to #bMaximus#k in any city. You can receive a gift for joining in the fun at #m960000000#.
QuestInfo.2: You got a #t4310015# from #p9070005#. Collect more of these, and you might get even more special items...

0.0: Hello #h0#! I'm #p9070005#, your guide to Battle Square! It's so nice to meet you! You must be here to learn about Battle Mode, huh? I'm shocked at how many Maplers know so little about one of Maple World's most thrilling festivities! Well, I'll lay it all out for you, so listen up!
0.1: Battle Mode is a #bgiant battle between the most powerful adventurers in all of Maple World#k. #bA battle not with monsters, but with each other#k! Woo hoo! Don't be scared by the word 'battle,' though. It's all in good fun!
0.2: The best part is, the harder you train, the more fun you have! Of course, you don't lose EXP if you get knocked out in Battle Mode, so there's nothing to lose. But as the say, seeing is believing. Give it a try for yourself!
0.3: If you want to join in Battle Mode, simply visit #b#p9070004# in any town#k. I'll be waiting for you at Battle Square!

no.0: What? You really don't want to try out Battle Mode? Think of it: A clash of swords! Musky sweat clouding the air around you! A feast of muscles! ...How could you resist?!

1.0: Welcome to Maple World Battle Mode! Joining is simple. Just talk to #b#p9070000##k. Now, let me explain it all for you.

yes.0: There are three types of matches in Battle Mode, but the basics are all the same. Defeat the enemy! That's all you really need to know. The only real difference is who you're fighting, and how many enemies you have.
yes.1: Number 1! #bFree-for-all#k is simple. Beat up everyone else! If you want to win, hit anything that moves. Easy, right?
yes.2: Number 2! #bTeam Match#k is a match between two teams. The eternal struggle of red against blue! Just...don't forget which team you're on, okay?
yes.3: Finally, number 3! #bIce Knight#k is a bit different. Ten people enter, and...one of them gets transformed into an Ice Knight! Yikes! Then the Ice Knight has to fight the other 9, all at once! Just thinking about it gives me chills!
yes.4: And that's all! I don't want to bore you. You're already here, so why not give Battle Mode a shot? Go for it! Talk to #b#p9070000##k, and prove your skills to the world!
